stories.text: Louisa Clarke opened a day and boarding school for girls in 1874, at 9 Park Terrace; called Western House, it moved here, to 30 The Ropewalk, in 1890. Rose Feilmann, who wrote "There are fairies at the bottom of my garden", was one of her pupils.
Jessie Batten, a London graduate of 1892, owned Western House school here from 1895. She married in 1910 but kept her own name at work, and retired in 1918.
